title: Apple Watch's AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing | TechCrunch
summary: The Audio Intelligence features for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 rely on a combination of Apple’s hardware, software, and services. Apple says none of these features should impact the battery life of your watch or phone.
